title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（石原正彦研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Ishihara Masahiko)
teachers:
ISHIHARA Masahiko
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
This course is intended to be the culmination of the student's individual curricular activities, including academic research, social implementation, creative materials, and so on.　Students will:
(1) Conduct and manage their own individual project
(2) Write a project report
(3) Make a public presentation of their work
advice:
This is a required course for senior students about to graduate from the university. Students are expected to conduct their own project autonomously, although they can receive instruction and advice from their supervisor. According to the basic course plan, students will perform the following:
1) Survey related research and relevant activities.
2) Set the clear and specific project goal.
3) Create an action plan to accomplish their goal.
4) Conduct the project according to the plan.
5) Write a project report and submit it to the system, Activity Support System for Design Project III, at the end of the year.
6) Make three presentations: two midterm summaries in the department and one public presentation in mid-February showing the project's final results.
requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to follow the guidance of their supervisor.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain clearly and specifically their goals in the course.
Be able to explain the background and related research for their project.
Be able to explain adequately the progress and interim results of their project.
Be able to explain adequately the final results and achievements of their project.
Be able to create and submit documents on Design Project III in the required format.
Be able to make a pubic presentation on the results of their project.
